chain_audit.description: STABLE 精确提交、UNSTABLE/NO_CANDIDATE/UNKNOWN_SEND/PROVIDER_FAILURE 停单与整单指标账目
chain_audit.gap_summary: commit_physical 与 episode 停单分支（selection.status not in ('selected','singleton') -> reason=status.upper()）已存在；但 geometry_order_execution.py:267 order_metrics 硬编码 cost={'model_calls':0,'service_cost':'NA_NO_SERVICE_CALL',...}。GP6 v18 需独立指标函数（如 geometry_jev_metrics_v1），从权威请求账本读取 send_reservations、model_calls、unknown_sends、failed_requests、usage、request_latency_s，费用不可得记 UNKNOWN。

chain_audit.description: SELECTED/MONITORED/COMMITTED 持久化恢复与请求账本重放防重发
chain_audit.gap_summary: GP5 的 _validate_saved_transitions 已支持 DECISION_READY/SELECTED/MONITORED/COMMITTED 阶段校验且不重选、不重评、不重提交，但未绑定 RequestLedger 的 attempt_id / raw_response_digest / UNKNOWN_SEND 终态校验；GP6 v18 恢复器需在校验 checkpoint 的同时核对 RequestLedger 对应 attempt 与 selection 一致，且遇到 SENDING/UNKNOWN_SEND 立即拒绝重发并终止。

minimal_versioned_gp6_proposal.design_principle: Strictly independent versioning; zero relaxation of GP5 v14-v17 schemas or local gates; zero change to DEFAULT_GEOMETRY_BACKEND (ems_surface_hybrid_v1) or explicit e2_original_v1 routing.
minimal_shared_routing_touchpoints_when_: packaging_versions.py: register v18 constants and closed schemas explicitly
contracts.py / config.py / packaging_runtime.py / candidate_backends.py / episode.py / selector.py / stability/monitor.py: add explicit v18 dispatch branches only, leaving v1-v17 unchanged
